executive_summary: FG proposes to raise Nigeria's maximum mortgage loan to ₦85 million and target 5,000 mortgages by 2028.

themes.label: FG Mortgage Ceiling Push: Expands Mid-Market Buyer Pool for Lakowe Annexe and LNT
themes.what_happened: The Federal Government announced plans to increase the maximum mortgage loan from ₦50 million to ₦85 million and to deliver 5,000 mortgages by 2028.
themes.why_it_matters_to_mixta: This expands the addressable buyer pool for Mixta's mid-market Lakowe Annexe plots (priced from ₦270,000/sqm) and Lagos New Town commercial plots (from ₦292,648.46/sqm), potentially accelerating receivables conversion and reducing the current sales receivables gap on Annexe by enabling more buyers to qualify for MOFI MREIF-linked financing.
themes.recommendation: Push the Lakowe Annexe pricing review to this week's executive committee meeting to capture the newly mortgage-eligible buyer segment before competitors adjust.
